title.en: The same execution id with a new Idempotency-Key is a 409 conflict

goal.en: The Idempotency-Key makes a retry safe; the execution id makes the run unique. Reusing the id with a different key is a conflict, while the original key still returns the original run.

note.en: Start a run with key ex-050-dup-k1.
Send the same request with a different key. The id already exists, so the answer is a Problem with title conflict.
The first run advances to the step that needs a person.
Send it again with the original key: the hub returns the first run, at its current state.

cli: jq '. + {"x-hub-human-present": true}' examples/core/execute-request.json | curl -s -X POST http://localhost:7878/v1/executions -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Idempotency-Key: ex-2026-10-04-001-a' -d @-

jq '. + {"x-hub-human-present": true}' examples/core/execute-request.json | curl -s -X POST http://localhost:7878/v1/executions -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Idempotency-Key: ex-2026-10-04-001-b' -d @-

outcome.en: You know how the two identifiers divide the work: one for retries, one for the run. Next: scenario 051 moves to the catalog side with an incident report.
